humaneval.protocol: HumanEval 164 tasks; one generated completion per task; generated code executed; incomplete output counted as failure

swe_bench.laro_lite: No tier score. One preselected development pilot task resolved by the upstream evaluator; 1/1 is mechanism evidence only.
swe_bench.laro_med: 12.5% clean development subset; 20.83% oracle-assisted development subset. Neither is leaderboard-comparable.

weight_training.note: No trained adapter beat the incumbent. No adapter result is marketed as an improvement.

runtime_caveat: The currently installed 8B preview runtime is a separate artifact and does not inherit the 4B or 12B HumanEval scores.
